info.title: Flowy API
info.description:
Welcome to the **Flowy API** — the REST backend for Flowy, a personal finance manager. Track income and expenses, plan budgets per category, save toward goals, monitor subscriptions, and collaborate in shared spaces.

Use the search bar (`Ctrl/Cmd + K`) to jump to an endpoint, or browse the tag groups in the sidebar. Every operation documents its authentication, rate limits, parameters and error responses.

## Base URL
All endpoints are served from `https://flowy-jade.vercel.app` (production); local and preview deployments use the same-origin server. Request and response bodies are `application/json` unless stated otherwise.

## Authentication
Every endpoint except `/api/health` and `/api/cron/alerts` requires an authenticated Supabase session — send either the session cookies or `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

## Tenancy
All data is scoped to the caller's active space (see `SpaceService.getCurrent`); personal data lives in the user's personal space.

## Errors
Non-2xx responses follow the `Error` schema with a `category` from `src/lib/errors/error-types.ts`. Zod validation failures return 400 with `message` + `errors` (the original Zod issues).

## Rate limiting
In-memory fixed-window limiter (per instance). Limits vary by route — see the `x-flowy-rate-limit` extension per operation. Exceeded requests return 429 with `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-*` headers. Disable with `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false`.

## Generated from code
This specification is **generated from code** (`pnpm generate:openapi`) and guarded against drift in CI.

servers.description: Same-origin — local development and preview deployments

externalDocs.description: Flowy on GitHub — source code, issues and roadmap

get.description: Paginated, filterable list of transactions in the active space. Rate-limited per user.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Comma-separated category UUIDs; matches transactions tagged with any of them

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on description or notes

post.description: Creates a transaction in the active space, or performs a bulk delete when `action: "bulkDelete"` is sent.

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed.

get.description: All categories in the active space, sorted by name.
All spaces the user owns or is a member of, with members.

post.description: Creates a space, or joins one when `action: "join"` with a join code is sent.

patch.description: Action-based: `setActive` switches the user's active space, `rename` renames it (owner only), `leave` leaves/deletes it, `removeMember` removes a member (owner only).

delete.description: Owner only; the last remaining space cannot be deleted.

get.description: Searches transactions, categories, budgets, goals and subscriptions in the active space. Queries shorter than 2 characters return an empty result.

post.description: Creates the profile row if missing (idempotent). Returns 201 on creation, 200 if it already existed.

patch.description: Sends the profile fields, or the theme fields (primaryColor/secondaryColor/accentColor).

get.description: Alerts for the active space (up to 50) plus the unread count.

post.description: Upserts the subscription for the authenticated user. 409 when the endpoint already belongs to another user.
Multipart/form-data with a `file` field. Returns the public URL of the stored receipt.
Multipart/form-data with a `file` field. Returns the public URL of the stored avatar.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the user's data (cascade) and the Supabase auth user.

post.description: Verifies the current password, then updates it.
Internal endpoint. Authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`. Evaluates alert rules for every profile and sends push notifications.

spaceId.description: Owning space UUID, or null for personal data

budgetId.description: Optional budget this transaction contributes to

Budget.description: Budget row with computed expenses/income/remaining for its month.

spaceId.description: Owning space UUID, or null for personal data

updatedBy.description: Profile UUID of the last editor, if any

month.description: Month 1–12, or null for a whole-year budget

expenses.description: Sum of expenses in the period

income.description: Sum of income in the period

spaceId.description: Owning space UUID, or null for personal data

updatedBy.description: Profile UUID of the last editor, if any

spaceId.description: Owning space UUID, or null for personal data

updatedBy.description: Profile UUID of the last editor, if any

active.description: Whether the subscription is currently active

entityType.description: Kind of entity the comment belongs to

joinCode.description: Invite code used to join a shared space

ownerId.description: Profile UUID of the space owner

isPersonal.description: Whether this is the user's private space

fingerprint.description: Dedup key so identical alerts are not repeated

readAt.description: When the user read the alert

showLanguageSelector.description: Whether to show the in-app language switcher

primaryColor.description: CSS color for the primary theme

secondaryColor.description: CSS color for the secondary theme

balance.description: Current balance across the active space

savingsRate.description: Savings rate (0–1) for the current month

prevSavingsRate.description: Savings rate (0–1) for the previous month

activeBudgets.description: Budgets with remaining limit in the period

dailySeries.description: Per-day income/expense series for the month

BudgetWithSpent.description: Budget with the amount actually spent so far.

amount.description: Amount when the result is financial

Error.description: Uniform error envelope. `category` is one of the ErrorCategory values in src/lib/errors/error-types.ts (validation, authentication, authorization, not_found, rate_limit, database, service_unavailable, network, server, unknown).

errors.description: Zod validation issues (message + errors only on 400s)

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the rate-limit window resets

RateLimitError.description: 429 response body. Include `Retry-After` in the next request.

SpaceActionRequest.description: Action-based space update. Only the fields for the chosen action are read: setActive → none; rename → name, isPersonal; leave → none; removeMember → memberUserId.

all.description: Mark every unread alert as read (takes precedence over ids)

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — body failed Zod validation or query parameters are invalid.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid authentication. Authenticate with the Supabase session cookie or `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The requested entity does not exist in the active space.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing data (e.g. duplicate name).

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the `Retry-After` header. Headers `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` describe the window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: ISO timestamp when the window resets

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token. Alternatively, authenticate with the Supabase session cookies (same session as the web app).

cronAuth.description: The server-side CRON_SECRET (not a Supabase token).
